## Welcome

Lionel Andrés Messi is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward. Over a career spanning more than two decades, he has redefined what is possible on a football pitch, combining close control, vision, and finishing to become the sport's all-time record holder for Ballon d'Or awards.

Born in Rosario, Argentina, and shaped by nearly two decades at FC Barcelona before moves to Paris Saint-Germain and Inter Miami, Messi's story is one of perseverance — overcoming a childhood growth-hormone condition — and sustained excellence at the highest level of the game.

> "I always try to focus on the present, because the past doesn't matter and the future isn't guaranteed."
> — Lionel Messi

Use the navigation above to explore his **background and career** and his **major achievements and impact** on the sport.
